hints.clean up noisy audio only: curl -X POST http://api.monid.ai/v1/run -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"provider":"elevenlabs","endpoint":"/v1/audio-isolation","input":{"body":<BODY>,"queryParams":<QUERY_PARAMS>,"pathParams":<PATH_PARAMS>}}'  # same rate, keeps the ORIGINAL voice
hints.list available voices: curl -X POST http://api.monid.ai/v1/run -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"provider":"elevenlabs","endpoint":"/voices","input":{"body":<BODY>,"queryParams":<QUERY_PARAMS>,"pathParams":<PATH_PARAMS>}}'  # the free voice catalog — use the target voice_id here
